submit_reasoning: The price history shows a clear downtrend from ~40 in early bars to ~35.58 at the end, with the most recent bars (125-130) showing an accelerated decline from 37.27 to 35.58. Series stats confirm: mean 38.72, last 35.58, CV 3.5%. No meaningful seasonality was detected (strength 0.0). Anomaly detection flagged 11 anomalies including the recent sharp drop to 35.58. I attempted to incorporate five context events from the article (earnings release date July 26, positive ESP +4.82%, upward EPS revision, Zacks Rank #2 Buy, four-quarter beat streak), but all were rejected by the ablation gate due to timestamp parsing issues. The Theta model was selected and produces a gently declining trajectory from 35.12 to 34.59 over 35 steps, consistent with the prevailing downtrend. While the article suggests a potential earnings beat could lift the stock, the model relies solely on price history since no context events were admitted. The forecast is marked as degraded support due to only 130 observations (140 needed for full calibration), but it is the best available.
